content: {"like": ["Matt Dillon’s acting has vastly improved and he returns to his natural style in this series.", "The show gives Dillon a lead role rather than a walk‑on or comedic part, offering a more substantial performance.", "Wayward Pines is described as a godsend and a chance to see Dillon in a serious, non‑comedic role."], "dislike": ["The series is intentionally confusing, with too many questions and not enough answers.", "It is not considered a great show and is seen as a disappointment compared to other series like Lost and Twin Peaks.", "The 10‑hour length of the film noir format is implied to be excessive.", "Season 2 is criticized for lacking Dillon and featuring an annoying character played by his son."]}
